intro.title: About Us
intro.description: This website is made to introduce the community to many people and to share many artworks from Yunayu and YUYUS!

yunayu.title: Yunayu
yunayu.description: Yunayu is a drawing hero! A very talented artist, coming to bless us with her amazing artworks. She also takes a lot of inspiration from the anime Bocchi the Rock!

facts.dream: Becoming a Manga Artist and making very awesome work!
facts.ambition: Becoming a Manga Artist and making very awesome work!

yunation.title: Yunation
yunation.description: Yunation is a community made by Yunayu! Yunation is not just an art community, but also a friendly platform for many things like gaming, music, photography and even programming!

website.title: About This Website
website.description: This website is made by the 'Programmer Hero' from Yunation! It was created to introduce the community to many people and to share artworks from Yunayu and YUYUS.

coder.title: About Coder: M.Fathin Halim
coder.description: M.Fathin Halim (or in Discord known as Coder Hero) is a middle school student who loves to code and wants to be a 'Programmer Hero'! He already made several projects including the Yunation website, and others in his Portfolio.
